claim_population.scope: primary_cases plus multi_intent_branches; scenario grounding is scored under follow_up

rules.comparison: Every record-specific claim_id must be present with all required source IDs; accepted source IDs, versions, evidence domain, and terminal must match the frozen contract.
rules.no_evidence: NO_EVIDENCE with an empty eligible-source set is correct without fabricated evidence.
rules.wrong_topic_authority: Any accepted source outside the record allowed_source_ids is wrong-topic authority.
rules.failure: Missing, fabricated, duplicate, wrong-source, wrong-version, wrong-domain, or wrong-terminal evidence fails closed.
